City of Encinitas
Mobility and Traffic Safety Commission Meeting
AGENDA
APRIL 13, 2026 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
San Diego County Sheriff’s Office Enforcement Report
Sergeant Kristy Trampus, San Diego County Sheriff’s Department
2026-04-13 MTSC Item 04A Enforcement Report
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES) Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.  Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk.  Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES
7A.
March 9, 2026, Regular Meeting Minutes
Approve the March 9, 2026, Regular Meeting Minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the Clerk.   Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.  A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
8A.
FY 2025-26 Mobility and Traffic Safety Commission Work Plan Update and Action Plan
Review, discuss, and take possible action on the FY 2025-26 Work Plan; receive a status update; and identify next steps.
2026-04-13 MTSC Item 08A 2025-26 Work Plan Update
8B.
Traffic Division Policies Update
Discuss and provide recommendations to staff regarding several Traffic Engineering Division policies.
2026-04-13 MTSC Item 08B Traffic Policies
8C.
FY 2026-27 Mobility and Traffic Safety Commission Work Plan Draft
Discuss and take possible action on potential work plan items for FY 2026-27.
2026-04-13 MTSC Item 08C 2026-27 MTSC Work Plan
9.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEMS Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
10.
COMMISSIONER CORNER AND POTENTIAL FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Roundtable and items to be added to a future agenda with consensus of two or more Commission members.
11.

11A.
Safety and Mobility Project Updates
2026-04-13 MTSC Item 11A Safety and Mobility Project Updates

ADJOURNMENT
